note: The enumerated security-critical set for mutation testing (mutmut / cosmic-ray) and coverage-guided fuzzing (cargo-fuzz + atheris). THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: the mutmut config (pyproject.toml [tool.mutmut]) and the cosmic-ray config (tools/mutation/cosmic-ray.toml) must mutate exactly the python files marked mutation=true here, and integration/tests/test_mutation_critical_set.py fails the build if any listed file is missing or the configs drift from this list. Categories: gate (WARDEN authorization AND the K4 customer billing/launch/settle authorization chokepoints), oracle (defensive detection/confirmation), verifier (tamper-evidence), signing (cryptographic authenticity, incl. the K4 completion-signal + per-slug delegation), parser (attacker-controlled-input decoders — the fuzz targets). The K4 money/settle guards that live on the SOVEREIGN leg (apps/sigil/*, assert_no_offense) are mutation=false: the scheduled python kill-suite is deliberately scoped to the vigil_core + sensitivity/fuzz meta-tests to stay tractable and cannot load framework alongside the sovereign-purity asserts, so those files are covered by the per-slice mutation-verify ritual + their named suites instead (the same reason models.py and the rust files are mutation=false).

critical_set.reason: The WARDEN tool->tier classifier + gate decision (sovereign port of tiers.rs). Lowering a dangerous tool below A3, or reaching A0 without a positive allowlist, is a fail-open.
The offense-side WARDEN gate: classifies + fail-closes every tool invocation before it can run.
The AEGIS gateway inline request/response inspector: parses the HTTP attack surface and runs the request-side oracles. A weakened check is a missed block; a broadened one is a false block.
confirm_finding: turns a lead into a CONFIRMED verdict only with a re-runnable certificate (prove-don't-guess). A mutation that confirms without proof manufactures evidence.
OracleVerifier: the deterministic re-execution authority behind every confirmation.
The tamper-evident hash-linked spine verifier (verify_chain / verify_head / anti-rollback). A mutation that verifies a tampered chain destroys audit integrity.
Deterministic canonical-JSON bytes + digest every signature is computed over. Non-determinism here silently breaks tamper-evidence.
Ed25519 sign / verify_one / verify_threshold: the cryptographic authenticity substrate. A verify that fails open is catastrophic.
pydantic spine-record models (ChainEntry / SignedChainHead). Data definitions with little branch logic; the record PARSER is exercised by the spine fuzz harness rather than mutation.

K4 completion->settle authenticity: sign_engagement_completion / verify_engagement_completion (Ed25519 threshold, fail-closed, tamper-reject). A verify that fails open lets a FORGED worker completion trigger a sovereign settle (a free or over-charged run). Mutmut/cosmic-ray cover it via the scheduled kill-suite (packages/core/vigil_core/tests/test_engagement_completion.py).

K4 production-execution HOLD: customer_prod_execution_enabled() is the fail-closed, default-OFF flag that keeps customer production-target execution disabled until the K4-6 acceptance matrix passes. A mutation flipping the default or inverting the truthy check lifts the hold silently. Covered by the scheduled kill-suite (packages/core/vigil_core/tests/test_posture.py).

K4 money chokepoint: reserve/publish/settle_launch -- exactly-once per (slug,nonce), consumed CLAMPED to the owner-signed reserved, settlement marker + seam tombstone (no double charge/refund/settle). Sovereign-leg (assert_no_offense), so it is NOT on the vigil_core-scoped scheduled kill-suite; covered by the per-slice mutation-verify ritual + apps/sigil/tests/test_k45_loopback_e2e.py (same rationale models.py/rust are mutation=false).

PP-1 enterprise postpaid: the owner-signed account-mode LWW registry (set_account owner-signed+FRESH; disable safe-direction on-sight/webhook-fresh; per-org high-water blocks replay-resurrection of a disabled line) + the ADDITIVE per-org arrears ledger (accrue/reverse idempotent per entry_id; accrued = debits-reversals clamped >=0; forged debit/credit inert) the launch gate draws against INSTEAD of prepaid credits (admit up to the owner-signed credit_limit, accrue, over-limit refuse; settle reverses the unconsumed draw, detected via the owner-signed debit record so it never mis-refunds to the prepaid wallet). v8 snapshot seed (postpaid_state/issued/row + postpaid_arrears_debited/credited/seen) + prune tripwires (spine/prune.py stranded_active_postpaid + stranded_postpaid_arrears). A weakened verify/high-water/clamp/limit guard lets a tenant draw past their line or a forged record move arrears. Sovereign-leg (assert_no_offense); per-slice mutation-verify ritual + apps/sigil/tests/test_postpaid.py + test_snapshot_fold_postpaid.py + test_postpaid_gate.py. PP-2 adds invoice_postpaid_arrears (bills the un-invoiced drawn DELTA each period from the owner catalog, idempotent per (org, period); reuses the invoice + arrears ledgers, no new spine record; payment->reversal deferred to PP-2b/prod-gated); covered by test_postpaid_invoicing.py (5/5 guards mutation-verified: delta no-double-bill, nothing-new guard, is_postpaid gate, postpaid-kind filter, catalog amount). PP-2 red-pen fold: the invoicing basis is net_settled_consumed = accrued - in_flight_reserved (an IN-FLIGHT reserve -- a RESERVE_ENTRY_PREFIX debit whose SETTLE_ENTRY_PREFIX settle record has not landed -- is held OUT of billing, so a reserved-but-unconsumed or later-cancelled launch is never over-billed; the gate+ledger share the reserve/settle entry-id prefixes so pairing cannot drift). A SECOND red-pen on the fold found + closed 3 confirmed money bugs: (HIGH) a full-consumption launch (refund==0) was billed $0 because the gate wrote the settle credit only `if refund > 0` -- fixed by PostpaidArrearsLedger.settle(refund>=0) which ALWAYS records the settle marker (even 0, a balance no-op that clears the reserve from the in-flight set), called unconditionally by launch_gate.settle_launch; (HIGH) a wall-clock/month period key dropped a same-month re-run's new delta (leak on close-before-rollover) -- fixed by content-addressing invoice_id on the per-org billing high-water invoiced_before (deterministic across processes: concurrent racers collide+dedup, sequential new deltas advance; period_end is now only a label); (MED) a hard prune of an in-flight reserve hid it from in_flight_reserved's live scan -> over-bill -- closed by the spine/prune.py stranded_active_postpaid_reserves tripwire (fail-closed: refuses any prune that would archive a reserve whose settle has not landed). 6 fold guards mutation-verified total (in-flight subtraction, settle-pairing exclusion, gate unconditional settle-marker, content-addressed invoice id, prune in-flight tripwire + its wiring); covered by test_postpaid_invoicing.py + test_postpaid_gate.py (full-consumption) + test_snapshot_fold_postpaid.py (tripwire). PP-2b adds invoice PAYMENT -> OUTSTANDING-balance tracking: a payment is a kind=payment receipt in the invoice ledger (price_id postpaid_payment), DISTINCT from the arrears ledger so it never lowers accrued / net_settled_consumed / invoiced_postpaid_total (the billing basis) -- it only moves postpaid_outstanding = invoiced - paid (clamped >=0, the scalar PP-3 dunning will test). pay_postpaid_invoice settles ONE named owner-signed postpaid invoice in full (amount from the invoice, never a wire value), idempotent per pay:{invoice_id} (first-mint-wins), org-scoped (fail-closed on unknown/non-postpaid/cross-tenant/empty). 3 guards mutation-verified (outstanding = invoiced-paid, pay idempotency, pay postpaid-kind filter); covered by test_postpaid_payment.py. invoices.py gains the payment kind (no new signal/snapshot; stranded_invoices covers it). PP-3 adds DUNNING -> credit-gate: postpaid_overdue_amount/postpaid_is_overdue flag a tenant with any UNPAID postpaid invoice past its net-terms due date (period_end + net_terms_days; PAID = a pay:{id} receipt exists), fail-closed (not overdue) on empty id / unknown account / non-finite clock; the launch gate (ui/launch_gate.py, now holding an InvoiceRegistry) adds an OVERDUE conjunct that refuses NEW reserves (the SAFE access-reducing direction, reversible on payment; an in-flight launch still settles), DISTINCT from the PP-1 credit-line cap. 3 guards mutation-verified (the gate dunning conjunct, the paid-exclusion, the due-date comparison); covered by test_postpaid_dunning.py + test_postpaid_gate.py (overdue-refuses-until-paid + prepaid-never-dunned).

Operator money sweeps: abandoned-reservation --apply full-refunds ONLY owner-verified, unsettled, past-TTL leases via the existing settle_launch path (exactly-once per (slug, nonce)); tx_ref sweep is report-only. A weakened verify/settled/TTL check refunds a forged, completed, or live reservation. Sovereign-leg; covered by apps/sigil/tests/test_ops_sweeps.py.

#4 offboarding cascade: org revoke FIRST (fail-safe) + membership cascade, plan cancel, and account+credential revoke ONLY when the decommissioned org was the customer's last active membership (no cross-tenant collateral); money records retained-but-unreachable. Sovereign-leg (assert_no_offense), so not on the vigil_core-scoped kill-suite; covered by the per-slice mutation-verify ritual (4/4 mutants killed) + apps/sigil/tests/test_decommission.py.

AEGIS-SaaS AE-4a: a tenant gateway seals each confirmed/lead verdict as a METADATA-ONLY report (no path/query/headers/body/actor) with a dedicated per-(tenant,host) HMAC report secret (domain-separated; never the pseudonymization secret; no signing key on the data plane), spools it atomically 0600/0700, rate-capped, and never raises into traffic. Only tenant-bound gateways report; spool and secret are configured together. Per-slice mutation-verify (8/8 killed) + framework/v2/aegis/tests/test_monitoring_report.py.

AEGIS-SaaS AE-3 per-request enforcement gating: a tenant-bound gateway re-authorizes EVERY request (AE-2 check) for its FIXED protected saas_host (never the client Host header); no valid authority => uninspected pass-through; OBSERVE never blocks; a hard block needs a verified BLOCK grant AND the default-OFF VIGIL_AEGIS_SAAS_ENFORCE flag AND enforce mode AND AEGIS_RESPOND AND an untripped kill-switch, on a confirmed certificate-carrying verdict. Legacy (no tenant) gateway byte-identical. Per-slice mutation-verify (11/11 killed incl. red-pen HIGH fold) + framework/v2/aegis/tests/test_saas_enforcement_gating.py.

AEGIS-SaaS AE-2: the keyless data plane's per-request monitoring-authority check (verify-only, holds no key). Verifies the published SignedMonitoringAuthority against the PINNED owner authority root (never an artifact-carried root), binds exact tenant + normalized host + half-open window, fail-closed and never raises (missing/malformed/oversized/symlink/FIFO/absent-root). Decides authorization+mode only; no enforcement (AE-3). Filename rule kept in lockstep with the sovereign publisher by test. Per-slice mutation-verify (11/11 killed) + framework/v2/aegis/tests/test_monitoring_authority_check.py.

AEGIS-SaaS AE-6: sovereign per-(org,host) monitoring REPORT-secret provisioning (random, 0600 in 0700, hashed filename, atomic, no silent overwrite) + fail-closed resolver for the drainer (exact pair; symlink/FIFO/group-readable/short/oversized => None). A weakened resolver lets one tenant's gateway forge another tenant's monitoring events. Sovereign-leg; per-slice mutation-verify ritual + apps/sigil/tests/test_monitoring_secrets.py.

AEGIS fold (AE-5): the SEPARATE owner-signed governor.monitoring_subscription line (never overwrites the credit-plan subscription; v7 snapshot seed + prune tripwire stranded_active_monitoring_subscriptions) and the continuous plan -> grant enforcement: cancel/past_due cascade-retires every grant, plan change retires block-without-respond and over-slot grants (earliest-issued kept), renewal re-mints prior-period grants via the provisioner, and the keyless reconcile sweep (sigil monitoring-reconcile / monitoring-drain watch) retires on a lapse with no webhook. A weakened guard keeps monitoring running for a tenant who stopped paying. Sovereign-leg; per-slice mutation-verify (21/21 killed) + apps/sigil/tests/test_monitoring_billing_fold.py.

AEGIS-SaaS AE-0: owner-signed defensive-monitoring grants (own != offense-test != observe != block). Grant requires a CURRENT ownership proof for the exact (org,host) and is clamped to its expiry; active_at re-checks ownership; forged grants inert; per-(org,host) LWW high-water blocks replay resurrection; v6 snapshot seed + prune tripwire (spine/prune.py stranded_active_monitoring_authorities). Sovereign-leg; per-slice mutation-verify ritual (10/10 killed; grant bound to the minted-against proof) + apps/sigil/tests/test_monitoring_authority_registry.py.

AEGIS-SaaS AE-1 monitoring mint path (monitor_authorize/monitor_revoke/monitor_list): default-OFF flag -> admit_customer(manage_monitoring, session org; disjoint from run_engagement/offense_authority) -> step-up AFTER admit -> registry grant (current ownership proof, server-capped window) -> owner-signed SignedMonitoringAuthority published atomically (0600/0700, hashed filename). A weakened gate lets a non-admin/cross-tenant caller mint monitoring authority or outlive the server window. Sovereign-leg; per-slice mutation-verify ritual + apps/sigil/tests/test_provision_monitoring.py.

AEGIS-SaaS AE-4b sovereign drain of gateway monitoring reports: bounded regular UTF-8 file only (symlink/FIFO/oversize quarantined), constant-time HMAC under the per-(org,host) report secret (never from the spool; cross-tenant forgery refused), freshness window, ACTIVE MonitoringAuthorityRegistry grant at receipt, content + report_id dedup, fail-closed quarantine; monitoring_events strictly org-scoped. Sovereign-leg; per-slice mutation-verify (16/16 killed incl. the custui/server/provisioner monitor_events route) + apps/sigil/tests/test_monitoring_spool.py.

K4 cross-plane settle seam: verifies the governance-signed EngagementCompletion against the owner-signed OFFENSE_GOVERNANCE_ROLE delegation, binds the signal to the published lease's tenant/nonce, then settles (owner-keyed). A weakened verify or tenant-bind settles on a forged or cross-tenant completion. Sovereign-leg; covered by the ritual + apps/sigil/tests/test_completion_spool.py.

K4 per-slug delegation mint: provision_launch_governance owner-signs a scoped, time-limited OFFENSE_GOVERNANCE_ROLE delegation (scope=cust_ slug, not_after=lease window+grace). A mutation widening the scope or window lets a completion signer act beyond its tenant/lease. Sovereign-leg; covered by the ritual + integration/tests/test_launch_governance.py.

K4 launch authorization conjunction: build_customer_launch_gate = verified CUSTOMER authority (refuses operator) AND owner-signed lease (verify_customer_launch_lease, floor not burned, K4-1 settlement re-check) AND the K4 prod-flag AND authorize_action (scope/window/kill-switch); host bound authoritatively from the authority scope, not extra. Covered by the ritual + integration/tests/test_engage_runner.py.

K4 exactly-once settle persistence + the cross-plane lease seam: read_credit_lease / record_lease_settlement / is_lease_settled / tombstone_credit_lease make a settled lease non-runnable and settle idempotent (the K4-1 money-doctrine close-out). A mutation to the settled-marker read/write reopens a double-settle. Covered by the ritual + the K4-5 e2e suites.

E2a customer-credential substrate (governor.customer_credential): owner-signed per-customer passkey/TOTP/OIDC-link records. verify_signed under the key-valid-at-seq + per-(username, cred_key) LWW high-water + GLOBAL uniqueness (a credential_id / (iss,sub) binds at most one customer) + fail-closed ambiguous resolution. A weakened verify / uniqueness / LWW lets a forged or duplicate-id credential resolve a login to the WRONG customer, or a captured active resurrect a revoked one. Sovereign-leg (assert_no_offense); covered by the per-slice mutation-verify ritual + apps/sigil/tests/test_customer_credentials.py.

E2b customer federated-identity gate (GoogleOidcIdentityProvider.verify): re-executes the id_token signature + registered-claim checks, then the STRICT customer gate — email_verified must be the JSON boolean True (not "true"/1/absent) and the STABLE (iss,sub) pair is the binding (email a hint only). A weakened email_verified check or a dropped (iss,sub) bind lets an unverified/forged Google identity auto-provision or resolve a login to the wrong customer (account takeover). Sovereign-leg (assert_no_offense); the owner-key / auto-provision / anti-takeover tail lives in ui/provision.oidc_finish. Covered by the per-slice mutation-verify ritual + apps/sigil/tests/test_customer_oidc.py (+ the edge round-trip in test_custui.py).
The Rust WARDEN classifier (source of truth for warden_tiers.py). Covered by cargo test + the cargo-fuzz warden_classify target, not by the python mutation run.
The kernel's Ed25519 + SHA-256 substrate. Covered by cargo test.
The signed, hash-chained WARDEN action log + anti-rollback head. Covered by cargo test (A10 durability).
